title: Paul and Barnabas in Lystra
description: Paul heals a lame man in Lystra, and the crowd believes Paul and Barnabas are gods (Hermes and Zeus) and wants to offer sacrifices to them. The apostles reject this and preach about the living God. Later, Jews from Antioch and Iconium arrive, and Paul is stoned and dragged out of the city.
